subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Leo did the same.”?
options: When old infrastructure loses its first purpose, it may still guide people through history in a new way.
Things that look alike still need a way to be told apart.
People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
A responsible city must sometimes look less perfect in order to protect what people truly need.
